posts.title: Sawbones: Can You Get Sexually Transmitted Diarrhea?
posts.description: It's a birthday treat for Justin McElroy and you – full of strange medical questions from listeners! Is it safe to use a vibrator on my ears? Does my sweat smell worse after I’m sick? Will eating cheesecake the night before mess up a blood test? And the question everyone is thinking but too afraid to ask: can I pee in the shower? Music: "Medicines" by The Taxpayers https://taxpayers.bandcamp.com/
